Alyssa (CS): quick weekly check for Novacore — usage up ~8% w/w, spend +22%. major ask: p95/p99 tail on /chat is hurting UX, customer asks for mitigation before renewal (in ~4 weeks). sharing p95/p99 split by route/model + streaming vs non-streaming below.

Alyssa (CS): DATA SNAPSHOT (last 7d aggregated)
/chat (redwood-alpha-7b) — streaming: p95 210ms, p99 520ms; non-stream: p95 430ms, p99 1,020ms
/summarize (redwood-lite-3b) — streaming: p95 140ms, p99 300ms; non-stream: p95 260ms, p99 610ms
/embed (embed-sm-1) — single: p95 80ms, p99 180ms; batched (4 req): p95 120ms, p99 340ms

Alyssa (CS): errors: overall 4xx ~0.6%, 5xx peaked to 0.9% on /chat non-stream during afternoon spike. KV cache hit-rate for Novacore ~58% (target 80%).

Alyssa (CS): immediate asks: can eng/ML triage tail causes and propose 72h mitigation plan (preferrably non-bill-impacting). Also need a short customer-facing blurb and an enablement call scheduled this week.

Devon (Eng): I see worker GC/oom churn around the spike window — attaching quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-04-02T15:32:21Z] worker-12 mem=7.9G -> GC pause 120ms  (alloc spike processing streaming chunks)
[2026-04-02T15:33:05Z] worker-8 reconnect fail -> 502 upstream timeout
```
Devon (Eng): early guess: streaming keeps longer-lived connections + larger KV footprint per session causing uneven batching and memory pressure. lowering max per-session tokens or preferring dedicated pool helps. I'll run a trace for /chat tail to confirm.

Ruth (ML): agree with Devon. two low-effort experiments to try as canaries:
- switch Novacore /chat to quantized variant `redwood-alpha-7b-q4` for 10% traffic (should cut p99 by ~25-30% CPU-bound tails)
- reduce default max_tokens from 512 -> 320 for their streaming endpoint (minimal UX impact for their use case)
Ruth (ML): I'll prepare the model canary config this morning.

Miguel (PM): renewal note: Novacore renews in 4w. If tail remains, risk moves to MEDIUM. propose we offer a 2-week performance trial + one-time credit if we hit p99 <700ms for /chat non-stream. Need CS + finance signoff.

Alyssa (CS): action items (assign):
1) Devon: collect flame/trace for 15:30 spike + KV usage breakdown (ETA today EOD)
2) Ruth: launch 10% q4 canary + report expected perf delta (ETA tomorrow AM)
3) Ops: toggle prefix caching knob for their tenant (quick test)
4) Miguel + Alyssa: draft renewal-safe offer & customer note (ETA 48h)

ops-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-443 Novacore-chat-high-tail-latency — https://infra/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-443

Devon (Eng): started trace job: `rb trace --tenant=novacore --route=/chat --window=15m --percentiles=95,99` — will drop results in the doc.

Ruth (ML): small note — embedding route is not streaming; recommend batching 4->8 for weekend bulk jobs to lower unit cost and smooth tails.

Alyssa (CS): scheduled enablement + review with Novacore Fri 10am PT. Thanks all — please drop updates in this thread and mark done when items complete. :thumbsup:
